Software Engineer II is a mid-to-senior full-stack role (5+ years expected) on Smartsheet's work-management platform, focused on views and real-time collaboration features. The work spans high-performance front ends — virtualized views rendering hundreds of thousands of rows — along with distributed back-end services, APIs, and data pipelines handling large datasets and high concurrency, plus the infrastructure and tooling around them. The core stack is React and Redux with TypeScript/JavaScript on the client, and Java, Ruby, Python, or Go on service-oriented cloud back ends.
